title: Integrating Machine Learning and Molecular Methods for Trichophyton indotineae Identification and Resistance Profiling Using MALDI-TOF Spectra.
summary: Partial least-squares discriminant analysis and support-vector machines classified 56 clinical isolates from MALDI-TOF spectra and examined ERG1 resistance correlation.
ai_technology: Partial least-squares discriminant analysis and support-vector machines classified 56 clinical isolates from MALDI-TOF spectra and examined ERG1 resistance correlation.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Cross-validated PLS-DA and SVM reached 100% balanced accuracy in the isolate dataset; this small laboratory cohort does not establish prospective clinical diagnostic performance.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
